children: AMC Robotics entered a financing package with Ayame Asset Holdings consisting of a Standby Equity Purchase Agreement (SEPA) for up to $50 million and pre-paid convertible notes totaling up to $3.88 million. The SEPA permits periodic equity sales at VWAP-based discounts, subject to a floor price, resale registration, and Nasdaq exchange cap limits; AMC issued 450,000 commitment shares and paid a $40,000 fee. The first note for $2.22 million funded on September 17, 2026, with a second $1.66 million to follow post-registration and stockholder approval; the notes mature on September 17, 2027 and are convertible at the lower of fixed or variable prices. A Registration Rights Agreement requires filing a resale registration within 21 days and targeting effectiveness within 60 days to facilitate resales.
